****Product Manager \- HR Technology****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Product Manager – Workforce AI (HR Technology) \| Hyderabad**
 Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Team: AI Product Management
   

  

 Reports to: Senior Director, Strategic Programs (AI Product Management)**
**About The Role**
 Cornerstone's Workforce AI platform is redefining how the world's largest organizations understand their people — building a skills\-first intelligence layer that connects workforce data, market signal, and a growing set of AI\-powered and agentic experiences.
   

  

 We're hiring a Product Manager in Hyderabad to drive execution across the Workforce Intelligence platform, working hand\-in\-hand with our engineering teams. This role sits close to the build: you'll own delivery of platform capabilities from spec through release, ensure quality across the release pipeline, and serve as the connective tissue between global product strategy and day\-to\-day engineering execution.
   

  

 This is a role for a PM who loves shipping — someone who is technical enough to earn engineering's trust, rigorous enough to own release quality, and customer\-minded enough to keep every sprint tied to real enterprise outcomes.
   

  

**In This Role You Will..**
 Own delivery of platform capabilities end\-to\-end: requirements, specs, sprint planning, release readiness, and post\-release quality
   

  

 Partner daily with engineering teams to translate product strategy into well\-scoped, buildable increments
   

  

 Drive the release process for your workstreams — release notes, gating criteria, risk identification, and cross\-team dependency management
   

  

 Own API and headless access capabilities, including agent tooling and developer\-facing experiences that let customers and partners build on the platform
   

  

 Write clear, structured product artifacts: PRDs, technical specs, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios
   

  

 Support enterprise customer deliveries by triaging escalations, validating fixes, and closing the loop between customer\-reported gaps and the roadmap
   

  

 Contribute to platform quality and compliance practices, including documentation supporting SOC 2 and responsible AI requirements
   

  

 Use AI\-assisted workflows as a core part of how you work — we build with AI, not just for it
   

  

**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**
 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally with enterprise SaaS or platform products — able to resolve a wide range of issues of diverse scope with good judgment in selecting methods and approaches
   

  

 Strong technical fluency — you can read an API contract, discuss data models with engineers, and translate system architecture tradeoffs to drive intended business outcomes
   

  

 Proven track record of shipping: you've owned releases, managed dependencies, and driven quality across a delivery pipeline
   

  

 Experience with enterprise platform products; familiarity with AI\-powered or LLM\-based features is a strong plus
   

  

 Crisp written communication — specs and status updates that engineers, executives, and customers can all act on
   

  

 Comfort operating across time zones with globally distributed product and engineering leadership
   

  

 Ownership mindset: you find gaps before they become escalations and close them without being asked
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

  

 Experience with HR tech, talent intelligence, skills platforms, or people analytics
   

  

 Familiarity with developer platforms: APIs, SDKs, webhooks, or agent/tool protocols
   

  

 Exposure to compliance\-driven product work (SOC 2, data privacy, EU AI Act)
   

  

 Hands\-on experience prototyping with AI coding tools
   

  

**Why This Role**
 You'll join a small, senior team building the AI backbone of a market\-leading platform, with exposure to global product leadership and enterprise customers — and you'll help define how AI\-native product teams operate.
   

  

 Cornerstone is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team
   

  

**Our Culture**
 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.

JOB ID: R\-252587 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 07, 2026 CATEGORY: Human Resources
The Senior Associate – HR Knowledge Management is responsible for managing and enhancing the HR knowledge ecosystem to support efficient, accurate, and user\-friendly access to HR information. This role combines strategic content management, platform stewardship, and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure HR knowledge is current, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate has a keen eye for detail, a passion for digital knowledge tools, and a proactive mindset in supporting a culture of self\-service and continuous improvement.

**Key responsibilities**

**Knowledge Content Strategy \& Governance**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality HR knowledge content across our internal knowledge platform, ServiceNow.
* Implement and manage content governance processes, including content lifecycle management, version control, and periodic audits.
* Ensure alignment of knowledge content with internal policies, and ensure consistent tone, format, and branding across all HR knowledge materials.

**Platform Ownership \& Optimization**

* Serve as a subject matter expert and administrator for HR knowledge management tools (e.g., ServiceNow Knowledge Base, SharePoint, Confluence).
* Optimize platform structure and taxonomy to improve discoverability, search performance, and user experience.
* Coordinate with DTI and HRI Tech teams to ensure system integrity and feature enhancements.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, and and other stakeholders/content owners to gather and validate content updates.
* Collaborate with the HR digital and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of knowledge assets into HR portals and service channels.

**Data\-Driven Improvements**

* Monitor usage analytics and employee feedback to identify knowledge gaps, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* Participate in knowledge audits and content lifecycle management initiatives
* Prepare and present regular performance and compliance reports to stakeholders.

**Enablement \& Support**

* Train and support content contributors and stakeholders on knowledge creation best practices and tool usage.
* Promote a culture of knowledge sharing and employee and manager self\-service through enablement and communication campaigns.

**Project Leadership**

* Lead or support large\-scale knowledge\-related projects (e.g., HR portal redesigns, chatbot integration).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that streamline access to HR knowledge and enhance service delivery.

**Qualifications**

* 5\-8 years of experience in HR, knowledge management, HR service delivery, or digital HR roles.
* Proven experience with knowledge management systems and content management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, SharePoint)
* Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, and shared services environments.
* Excellent collaboration, communication and technical writing skills.
* Analytical and proactive mindset with experience interpreting content usage metrics and drawing insights.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects in a fast\-paced environment.

title: AI Engineering Lead
description:
* Hyderabad, India
* Permanent
**ABOUT FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT**


Flutter Entertainment is the **world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator** with **15\.9 million** Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of **$16\.4 billion** in 2025\. We have a **portfolio of iconic brands** , including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.  



Flutter Entertainment is listed on the **New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).** We’re proud to be recognized by **TIME** as one of the **World’s Best Companies 2025** — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.  



Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing **portfolio of brands** across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.


**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**


Our office in the heart of **Hi\-Tech City** , Hyderabad, serves as **Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC).** Now home to 1,000\+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data \& Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech \& Analytics.  



Our Values define us. They are \- **Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day.**
  

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day.  



With ambitious growth plans for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them, we continue to serve our customers and care for our **communities** with the talent and passion of our **colleagues** .
  

  

**OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE**


Flutter Functions' AI \& Automation team is seeking an experienced **you** to build and lead a high\-performing pod of 2–3 AI developers. You'll own the technical vision and execution of Flutter's **enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms** — intelligent systems that leverage our vast internal data assets to enhance productivity and decision\-making across our sports betting and gaming operations at global scale.


As an AI Engineering Lead, you'll combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership, mentoring a talented team while driving the architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering practices that power next\-generation AI solutions. You'll have direct impact on both the platform's capabilities and the growth trajectory of your team members.


Working in a hybrid environment that blends remote flexibility with collaboration in our modern Hyderabad offices, you'll partner with product leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambitious AI initiatives into production\-grade systems serving over 20 million customers across 20\+ regulated markets.


**What You'll Do**

**Technical Leadership \& Architecture**

* **Platform Vision \& Strategy:** Establish the technical direction for Flutter's enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms, making architectural decisions around LLM inference, agentic frameworks, guardrails, and system design that balance innovation with operational excellence.
* **LLM Inference \& Optimization:** Lead the selection, deployment, and optimization of LLM inference systems — **LiteLLM, AWS Bedrock** , and emerging alternatives — establishing patterns that your team follows, including model routing strategies, cost management, and latency optimization.
* **Context Engineering \& Prompt Architecture at Scale:** Design sophisticated, production\-grade context pipelines and prompt architectures — establishing team best practices, code patterns, and evaluation frameworks that ensure consistency and quality across all platform components.
* **Model Tokenomics \& Trade\-off Analysis:** Mentor your team in understanding and reasoning about token economics, latency budgets, context window trade\-offs, and capability\-to\-cost ratios — embedding this thinking into architectural review processes and technical decisions.
* **Guardrails, Safety \& Compliance:** Architect robust model constraint and guardrail systems aligned with Flutter's Responsible AI Policy and regulatory obligations. Lead the security\-first mindset across the pod, ensuring AI outputs remain safe, compliant, and auditable across 20\+ regulated markets.
* **Agentic Framework Mastery:** Deep expertise across multiple agent frameworks ( **LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK** ) — make informed choices about which frameworks and patterns solve which problems, establish team standards, and guide your developers in building sophisticated multi\-agent orchestrations.
* **Full\-Stack Problem Ownership:** Model end\-to\-end ownership — architecting solutions from LLM integration through backend services to user\-facing interfaces, and cultivating this mindset within your team so complex problems don't get siloed or handed off prematurely.
* **API \& Integration Design:** Design clean, scalable APIs and integration patterns using AWS services (Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway), **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** , and modern standards — establish team conventions that make integration predictable and maintainable.

**People Leadership \& Team Development**

* **Team Building \& Mentorship:** Hire, onboard, and actively mentor a pod of 2–3 AI developers — helping them grow from their current level towards technical leadership, fostering a culture of learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
* **Technical Skill Development:** Guide your team through the rapidly evolving AI landscape — mentoring on LLM inference systems, context engineering, agentic patterns, and security practices; helping them stay current with emerging tools and frameworks.
* **Code Review \& Technical Standards:** Establish and enforce technical standards across the pod — conducting rigorous code reviews, catching architectural issues early, and using review processes as teaching moments rather than gatekeeping exercises.
* **Incident Leadership \& Problem\-Solving:** Lead the team through production incidents, post\-mortems, and challenging technical problems — modelling a blameless culture while ensuring systemic improvements emerge from failures.
* **Career Development \& Growth Paths:** Create individual development plans for each team member, identify growth opportunities, and actively sponsor their advancement within Flutter — whether toward senior IC roles or their own leadership tracks.
* **Psychological Safety \& Culture:** Foster a team environment where curiosity is rewarded, failure is learnable, and people feel empowered to propose ideas, challenge assumptions, and take calculated technical risks.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Delivery**

* **Product \& Stakeholder Partnership:** Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions — balancing ambition with delivery realities and keeping the team focused on high\-impact work.
* **Data Science \& Engineering Partnerships:** Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineering teams across Flutter's organisation to integrate AI solutions into existing infrastructure, ensuring consistency and operational excellence.
* **Technical Communication:** Articulate complex AI concepts to non\-technical audiences, present architectural decisions to leadership, and translate business needs into technical priorities for your team.

**Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI**

* **Security\-First Mindset Leadership:** Champion a security\-oriented approach across all AI development — ensuring the pod reasons about prompt injection risks, data leakage vectors, authentication flows, access control, and sensitive data handling from day one.
* **Responsible AI Governance:** Ensure all platform development aligns with Flutter's Responsible AI Policy and regulatory compliance requirements — conducting design reviews, establishing testing practices, and creating guardrail frameworks that scale.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**
**Core Requirements**

* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, or a related STEM field, with **5\+ years of software development experience, of which 2–3\+ years focused on AI/ML or agentic systems development.**
* **Proven Leadership:** Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring technical teams (even informally) — showing ability to grow people, establish technical direction, and drive delivery through others.
* **Deep Python \& Backend Expertise:** Advanced Python proficiency with experience in production frameworks (FastAPI, Flask), async patterns, and the ability to architect scalable backend systems.
* **LLM Inference Systems Mastery:** Hands\-on expertise with **AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM** , and similar inference platforms — deep understanding of model routing, API design, cost optimization, and deployment patterns at production scale.
* **Context Engineering \& RAG Expertise:** Demonstrated ability to design and evaluate sophisticated context pipelines, retrieval\-augmented generation systems, and prompt architectures — with understanding of trade\-offs and best practices.
* **Model Tokenomics \& Architectural Trade\-offs:** Strong ability to reason about token economics, latency budgets, context limits, and capability\-to\-cost ratios when making architectural decisions — mentoring others to think this way.
* **Agentic Framework Proficiency:** Deep experience with at least 2–3 agent frameworks ( **LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK, CrewAI** ) — understanding of orchestration patterns, tool\-use design, multi\-agent coordination, and when to use which patterns.
* **Guardrails \& Responsible AI:** Substantial experience with model constraint mechanisms, content filtering, guardrail systems, and responsible AI principles in production environments — able to architect these at scale.
* **Security\-Oriented Mindset:** Strong security fundamentals applied specifically to AI — understanding prompt injection, data exfiltration, model misuse vectors, and standard patterns (OAuth, JWT, least\-privilege design).
* **AI\-Augmented Development Practices:** Proficient using AI coding tools ( **Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode** ) as genuine productivity multipliers — able to validate AI\-generated code and teach others to do the same.
* **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Expert\-level knowledge of SDLC, version control (Git), API design, system architecture, and collaborative engineering at scale.
* **Communication \& Influence:** Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences; skilled at influencing without authority and building consensus.

**Highly Desirable Skills**

* **Full\-Stack Experience:** Demonstrated ability to own end\-to\-end problems across the stack — experience with **React, TypeScript** , modern frontend patterns, backend services, and AI integration — showing where full\-stack ownership adds value.
* **Advanced Vector Databases \& RAG:** Hands\-on experience designing and operating production RAG systems using vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, Weaviate) at scale.
* **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Deep understanding of MCP and its role in standardising tool and context integration across modern AI agent systems — ideally with implementation experience.
* **Open\-Source Contributions:** Active contributions to AI/ML or agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.) — demonstrating commitment to the broader AI community.
* **Regulated Environment Experience:** Prior experience in gaming, sports betting, financial services, or heavily regulated tech environments where compliance, safety, and auditability are non\-negotiable requirements.
* **Prior Leadership Success:** Track record of successfully growing engineers, building high\-performing teams, or leading technical initiatives that shipped material business impact.
* **Curiosity \& Thought Leadership:** Demonstrated appetite for staying at the bleeding edge of AI development — active in community discussions, opinionated about technology choices, comfortable forming and defending positions on where the field is heading.

**BENEFITS WE OFFER**


* Access to **Learnerbly, Udemy** , and a **Self\-Development Fund** for upskilling.
* Career growth through **Internal Mobility Programs** .
* Comprehensive **Health Insurance** for you and dependents.
* Coverage of **OPD Consultations** and **Full Body** health checkup every year.
* **Well\-Being Fund** and **24/7 Assistance Program** for holistic wellness.
* **Hybrid Model** : 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.
* **Free Meals, Cab Allowance** , and a **Home Office Setup** Allowance.
* **Employer PF Contribution** , gratuity, Personal Accident\& Life Insurance.
* **Sharesave Plan** to purchase discounted company shares.
* **Volunteering Leave** and **Team Events** to build connections.
* Recognition through the **Kudos Platform** and **Referral Rewards** .
**WHY CHOOSE US**


Flutter is an **Equal Opportunity Employer** and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.


We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.
  

  

If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences, and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

title: Senior Manager - HR
description:
This role is responsible for end\-to\-end HR for the assigned region while acting as a Business Partner to business leaders, ensuring alignment of people practices with business objectives. This is an Individual contributor role and requires working closely aligned with the Corporate HR.

* Experience– **8\-12 years** of HR experience preferably from B2B sales trading companies.
* Work location – **Hyderabad Gachibowli (Full time \\ In\-Office only)**
* Candidate should be multi\-lingual verbal communication proficient in **Telugu \& Hindi** Mandatory

**Role Expectations:** 

* Strong execution\-focused role with hands\-on responsibility for HR operations and recruitment.
* Supports managers with guidance; escalates complex issues when required.
* Ownership of regional HR agenda and business partnering.
* Global business experience is added advantage
* Education MBA HR

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Business Partnering**

* Act as a single point of contact for business leaders in the assigned region on all HR matters.
* Provide guidance on workforce planning, organization structure, productivity, and talent deployment.
* Support change management initiatives and business transformation projects.

**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning**

* Drive regional manpower planning in coordination with business heads.
* End\-to\-end recruitment for the region (sourcing, interviewing, hiring, onboarding).
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for critical roles.

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Handle employee relations issues including grievances, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, code of conduct, and disciplinary procedures.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and support a positive workplace culture.
* Conduct regular employee connect sessions and exit interviews; analyze trends and recommend actions.

**Performance Management \& Talent Development**

* Facilitate performance management cycles (goal setting, reviews, appraisals).
* Identify training and development needs and coordinate learning initiatives.
* Support succession planning and development of high\-potential employees.

**Compensation, Benefits \& HR Operations**

* Support implementation of compensation, incentives, and benefits as per company policies.
* Ensure accurate and timely execution of HR operations including confirmations, promotions, transfers, and exits.
* Coordinate payroll inputs and ensure data accuracy.
* Maintain employee records and HR MIS for the region.
* Implement HR policies and SOPs consistently across the region.

**Reporting \& Stakeholder Management**

* Prepare and present HR reports, dashboards.
* Coordinate with Corporate HR on policy alignment, projects, and reporting.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth HR service delivery.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)
description:
**HR Business Partner (HRBP)**
------------------------------


### **Department: HR**

### **Job ID: 2026190**

### **1 Open Positions**

### **6\+ years**

### **Hyderabad, India**

### **Objective**

To provide effective Human Resource Business Partnering support to business and project leadership, ensuring smooth HR operations, strong employee relations, statutory compliance, and workforce alignment with organizational goals.


### **Skills Required**

HR Business Partnering, Employee Relations, Statutory Compliance, Manpower Planning, PMS \& KRAs, Multi\-Site HR Operations, Contract Labour Management, HRMIS \& Payroll Coordination


### **Qualification**

Post Graduate – MBA (Human Resources)


### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide comprehensive HR support to line management, including organization structure management, training, grievance handling, performance appraisals, transfers, deputations, disciplinary actions, and statutory compliance
* Work closely with project heads to manage employee relations and maintain a positive and productive work environment
* Manage site HR teams and ensure smooth and consistent HR operations across all sites within the assigned business unit
* Act as the single point of contact for Project Heads for all HR\-related activities
* Coordinate with site HR teams for new joiner induction and onboarding formalities
* Drive manpower planning, maintain and update organization charts in line with business requirements
* Coordinate with the Talent Acquisition team to ensure timely deployment of manpower as per SLAs and PIPs
* Ensure completion of KRAs and PMS cycles (Mid\-Year and Annual)
* Coordinate with Compensation \& Benefits for leave management, attendance, payroll, and full \& final settlements within the business unit
* Promote and track training \& development initiatives at sites and submit periodic reports
* Manage contract labour HR activities, including agreements, PR/PO coordination, as required
* Initiate and manage disciplinary actions as per policy
* Submit HRMIS reports on a monthly basis
* Ensure 100% digitization of attendance systems across sites
### **Qualification \& Experience**

* Post Graduate – MBA (Human Resources)
* Minimum 6 years of hands\-on HRBP / HR Operations experience
* Proven experience in handling large workforces of 100\+ employees
* Experience in Non\-IT organizations preferred
* Strong exposure to employee relations, statutory compliance, and multi\-site HR operations

title: Senior Specialist - Oracle Fusion ERP Technical
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.



**About the Role**



Senior Specialist \- Oracle Fusion ERP Technical responsible for supporting technical development, integrations, reporting, and environment\-related activities across Oracle Fusion ERP. The role will be based out of India, Hyderabad GCC, and will work closely with functional teams, business users, and external partners to deliver reliable technical solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Develop, enhance, and support BI Publisher reports, OTBI analyses, data models, templates, and extracts across Oracle Fusion ERP
* Build and support Oracle Integration Cloud integrations, including scheduled integrations, file\-based integrations, REST/SOAP services, and exception handling
* Support Oracle Fusion technical activities across ERP modules such as Finance and SCM, including issue analysis, data validation, and technical troubleshooting
* Assist with instance clone, environment refresh, post\-refresh validation, setup checks, and coordination with Oracle support or managed service partners
* Work with functional consultants and business users to convert requirements into technical designs, reports, integrations, and support fixes
* Maintain technical documentation, follow change control processes, and ensure stable support for production and non\-production environments


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 4 to 7 years of hands\-on Oracle Fusion ERP technical experience
* Strong experience in BI Publisher reports, data models, bursting, templates, parameters, SQL, and report performance troubleshooting
* Hands\-on knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud, including integrations using REST/SOAP, FBDI, scheduled jobs, error handling, and monitoring
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion instance clone, environment refresh, post\-refresh validation, user/security checks, and related coordination tasks
* Good understanding of Oracle Fusion ERP modules, preferably Finance and SCM, from a technical support perspective
* Ability to analyze production issues, work with functional teams, and provide timely technical fixes or workarounds


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Tech, MCA, M.Tech, MBA, or equivalent degree
* Experience in post go\-live support or steady\-state Oracle Fusion operations
* Exposure to Oracle SaaS environment management, quarterly update testing, and regression validation
* Knowledge of FBDI, ADFDI, ESS jobs, HDL or HSDL, security roles, and Oracle support processes
* Experience in pharma, life sciences, or regulated environments is a plus


By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Senior Associate, Generalist, HR Relationship Management
description:
The incumbent supports the senior BHR for assigned BU/SU and is responsible for designing and delivering effective people\-based solutions across the allocated teams. The BHR ensures execution of the people strategies; tracking all the key HR metrics and works closely with product function / CoEs to make the employee experience seamless.


Key Responsiblities


* Partner with front line managers \& leaders as a trusted advisor and drive the people agenda for the assigned businesses/teams.
* Driving continuous employee connect and employee engagement.
* Drive Performance, Productivity and holistic engagement of the employees.
* Partner closely with the Product teams / CoEs to drive the experience and impact of HR offerings, and provide on ground feedback
* Support the business on holistic HR aspects
* Responsible for managing the key HR metrics for the functions managed
* Provide strategic interface to stakeholders through the provision of high quality guidance and support in developing and progressing people management solutions to achieve business objectives
* Coach, support, mentor and challenge managers in the application of HR policies and practices, provide advice and guidance on complex HR issues
* Drive employee engagement and connect for the business / function
* Reviewing and analysing business specific data to identify trends \& recommend solutions to business leaders.
* Performance management \& productivity enhancement including PIP (Performance Improvement Plan) management.
* Ensure that there is continuous feedback from managers including process management for key HR processes.
* Manage talent management activities for the business / function.
* Extensive interaction with CoE to drive the HR agenda for the business / function.
* Support the Year End compensation process balancing the adherence to Group principles and the business nuances.
* Build a culture of Risk, Control and Conduct, ensure awareness at employee level for all key guidelines.
* Partner with the business / function for Engagement Survey roll out (My Voice), post survey finding action planning, and ensure that the survey feedback is actioned upon.
* Act as a change agent to the business, designs processes and approaches which prepares employees for ongoing change \& transformation.
* Organisational diagnosis, design \& development which takes consideration of external trends, conditions and applies best practice to design, develop and facilitate high individual and organisational performance.
* Continuous engagement with employees to keep an on group pulse

Required exp.


* 6\-9 years of experience in HR, with strong business partnering background
* Hands\-on experience in some of the core domains in HR
* GCC HR Experience would be a preference (not mandatory)

Education / Preferred Qualifications


* MBA in HR or equivalence would be preferred.

Hyderabad \- DTI Waverock SEZ

Regular

title: Payroll Analyst
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Employee Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


The ES People and Payroll Specialist is a member of a globally diverse team providing mentorship and assistance to geographically dispersed employees across India, Australia, Singapore, and the broader APAC region using the latest Salesforce technology. The successful candidate has strong organizational, time management, and communication skills, along with a keen attention to detail, a commitment to outstanding customer support, and the ability to establish relationships at every level of the organization. This person must be comfortable dealing with highly sensitive and confidential matters. Our ideal candidate possesses an AI\-first mindset, enjoys self\-directed learning in dynamic, fast\-paced environments, and is interested in gaining exposure to a variety of regional HR subject areas.


Your Impact:


Provide superior customer service to employees and managers of Salesforce via our Basecamp customer portal and other social channels.


Support our knowledge base within Basecamp; close knowledge gaps by creating, updating, and improving knowledge articles to keep information relevant for employees’ self\-service.


Record and supervise all customer interactions using a case management tool, responding to inquiries on Payroll, benefits, time off, compensation, immigration, HR policy, and employee data. Follow through to ensure all assigned cases are resolved and closed timely and appropriately.


Partner with third\-party payroll vendors (such as ADP) to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing and data synchronization across the APAC region.


Develop an understanding of Workday as a tool and leverage its capabilities for manager and employee self\-service process inquiries.


Apply an AI\-forward mindset to proactively identify inefficiencies and collaborate towards an improved, modern process that enhances the employee and/or manager’s experience.


Maintain an appropriate level of process, program, and policy knowledge in order to assist employees across multiple countries and jurisdictions.


Assist with User Acceptance Testing for system enhancements and AI\-driven HR tools.


Participate in regional/Global projects to further improve and modernise ES People Services and Payroll processes for a seamless employee experience.


Requirements:


Minimum 2 years of experience in a payroll, HR, or shared services environment supporting APAC countries (specifically India, Australia, and Singapore).


Prior experience with Workday HCM or a similar HRIS is highly desirable.


Experience working in a case management system.


Prior experience supporting an end\-to\-end payroll cycle by inputting and validating employee data changes alongside third\-party payroll vendors like ADP.


Strong understanding of regional tax deductions, statutory contributions, and compliance (e.g., Superannuation in Australia, CPF in Singapore).


Experience with APAC payroll legislation and supporting year\-end payroll activities, including internal and external payroll audits.


Possess an AI mindset with a strong ability to self\-learn, adapt to new technologies, and drive automation in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


Exceptional problem\-solving skills with a strong desire for data integrity, process definition, and continuous learning.


Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


The ability to navigate and collaborate with employees through personal circumstances with empathy and professionalism.


Ability to diagnose a problem and lead correction efforts through effective communication and execution.


Superior employee experience focus with the ability to manage competing priorities.


Ability to maintain strict confidentiality in all aspects of job responsibilities.


Ability to work effectively in a team setting.


Experience working in an HR shared services organization for an established, multinational company is ideal.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* .
